<!--
HOW merge_models.qmd CONSUMES THIS (OCC_RULE=1, the orchestrator wires it; nothing here couples through a flag):

  data/v11/zone_weights_occ.csv     = msens::encounter_weight() at the defaults, one row per (mdl_key, zone_key) with w < 1
  (REGION_WEIGHT=1: multiply the merged value by w inside the zone via cell_zone_major_sql; w = 0 rows are the gate).
  data/v11/zone_exclusions_occ.csv  = msens::occurrence_exclusions(gate = OCC_GATE) at the D10 defaults, one row per GATED
  (mdl_key, zone_key), the shape msens::zone_exclude_sql(id_col = "mdl_key") takes, with the counts and the
  verdict that justify the row. data/manifests/explore_occurrence_rule.json records the CSV's xxhash64.

RESUMABILITY (every expensive step is a cache under {dir_big_v}/marine-atlas/occ/, rebuilt only if missing
or REDO_OCC=1): obis_sp, worms_lineage, effort_blocks, region_rec_{d}km, taxa, ch, and one counts/{sig}/{batch}.parquet
per batch of taxa. A killed render resumes at the first batch without a file.

SMOKE TEST: OCC_TEST_N=<n> runs the anchors plus the first n other taxa, writes nothing to data/ and skips the
final assertion unless the anchors were run. OCC_SRC_VER points the rule at another version's merged outputs.
-->

## Goal

v7c removed two things by hand-evidenced rows: the sea turtles from the East Bering Sea (zero records in nine channels)
and the North Atlantic right whale from the Gulf of America ecoregions (an "outside range" judgment). Tim White
(2026-10-21) asked for one written rule that treats both the same way, with tiers: protected places override,
"unsampled is unknown, not absent", wide-ranging taxa. The rule is `msens::occurrence_rule()` (msens 0.63.0, a wrapper
of `region_effort_test()`, rule E of `obis_range_constraint.qmd`): per ecoregion, the species' modelled 0.5-degree blocks
that were **searched** (a record of its effort group exists) against those that hold a record of the species, judged
against the species' record rate in its OTHER ecoregions (`OCC_BASELINE=zones`, the default since msens 0.63.0; `range` =
the whole modelled range, the rule as first written, kept below as a sensitivity: the right whale's modelled range spans
the North Atlantic, most of it unsurveyed in OBIS, and against that diluted baseline its Gulf pairs could not be
significantly fewer); an ecoregion is dropped only when records are significantly (binomial p < alpha) AND materially
(rate < ratio x the baseline rate) fewer, kept when nobody looked.

This notebook runs that rule at the D10 defaults over **every scored taxon x the 12 MMA ecoregions** and tabulates it
by component. It writes `data/v11/zone_exclusions_occ.csv`, which `merge_models.qmd` consumes under `OCC_RULE=1`.

**Scope of this version of the notebook.** Records come from **OBIS only** (the obisindicators `obis_cell` export,
`libs/obis_h3.R`). GBIF through `speciesgrids`, iNaturalist and the Alaska stranding / observer channels are later
additions (plan 2026-10-29 section 4.3, D10): more channels can only add searched blocks and records, so a drop here
that disappears with GBIF is a channel gap, and the anchors are read with that in mind (the Gulf of Alaska turtles
are reported, not asserted).

Defaults (D10): effort = megafauna records for air-breathers (mammals, turtles, birds) and the taxon's own order for
the rest; buffer d = `OCC_BUFFER_KM` (100 km: a record just outside an ecoregion counts, for RECORDS and EFFORT
only; presence stays inside the ecoregion); ratio 0.25, alpha 0.05, 0.5-degree blocks, no recency weight, critical
habitat and narrow-range (< 20 cells) overrides, all taxa. One data-quality choice is not in D10: OBIS records dated
before 1950 are ignored (`OCC_YEAR_MIN`, as `obis_range_constraint.qmd` did); records without a year are kept.

## Design

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-design
%%| fig-cap: "OBIS records + the v10 modelled range, per species x ecoregion, through occurrence_rule()"
flowchart LR
  obis[("obis_cell + worms_taxon<br/>(obisindicators release)")] --> sp["records per species x cell<br/>+ order / megafauna effort blocks"]
  rng[("v10 merged GLOBAL surfaces<br/>(AquaMaps for am-only taxa)")] --> pr["present blocks<br/>(val >= 1)"]
  zc[("ecoregion zone_cell")] --> rg["majority region<br/>+ region_rec (d km)"]
  ch[("ch_fws / ch_nmfs / ca_nmfs")] --> rule
  sp --> rule["occurrence_rule()<br/>per batch of taxa"]
  pr --> rule
  rg --> rule
  rule --> ver["verdict: kept / dropped / unsearched<br/>+ overrides"]
  ver --> csv["data/v11/zone_exclusions_occ.csv<br/>(merge_models, OCC_RULE=1)"]
  ver --> tab["tables: anchors, components,<br/>sensitivity (d x effort x ratio)"]
```

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

librarian::shelf(
  DBI, digest, dplyr, duckdb, fs, glue, here, jsonlite, knitr, purrr, readr, stringr,
  tibble, tidyr, MarineSensitivity/msens, quiet = T)
source(here("libs/paths.R"))          # ver, ver_prev, dir_big, dir_big_v, obis_h3_*
source(here("libs/vars.R"))           # .flag(), occ_buffer_km
source(here("libs/duckdb_budget.R"))  # duckdb_tune()
source(here("libs/obis_h3.R"))        # obis_h3_src(), obis_h3_info()

stopifnot(
  "msens >= 0.64.1 (occurrence_rule(baseline), occurrence_exclusions(gate), encounter_weight, cells_within_sql) is required; reinstall msens" =
    packageVersion("msens") >= "0.64.1" && all(c("occurrence_rule", "occurrence_exclusions", "encounter_weight", "cells_within_sql") %in% getNamespaceExports("msens")))

# parameters ---- (env-overridable; the defaults are D10's)
redo_occ     <- .flag("REDO_OCC")                                  # rebuild every cache below
occ_test_n   <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("OCC_TEST_N", "0"))          # smoke test: anchors + first n taxa, writes nothing to data/
occ_alpha    <- as.numeric(Sys.getenv("OCC_ALPHA", "0.05"))
occ_ratio    <- as.numeric(Sys.getenv("OCC_RATIO", "0.25"))
occ_block    <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("OCC_BLOCK", "10"))          # cells per block side: 10 = 0.5 degrees on global05
occ_min_cells<- as.integer(Sys.getenv("OCC_MIN_CELLS", "20"))      # narrow-range override below this many cells worldwide
occ_year_min <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("OCC_YEAR_MIN", "1950"))     # OBIS records dated earlier are ignored (NULL year kept)
occ_baseline <- match.arg(Sys.getenv("OCC_BASELINE", "zones"), c("zones", "range"))   # what a zone is judged against (msens 0.63.0)
occ_gate     <- match.arg(Sys.getenv("OCC_GATE", "zero"), c("zero", "all"))            # D11: gate = zero records (default) | every dropped pair
occ_nc       <- 7200L                                              # global05 columns
d_default    <- occ_buffer_km                                      # libs/vars.R OCC_BUFFER_KM, default 100
d_all        <- sort(unique(c(0, 100, 250, d_default)))            # sensitivity buffers (km)
ratio_all    <- sort(unique(c(0.25, 0.5, 1, occ_ratio)))
cap_rows     <- as.numeric(Sys.getenv("OCC_BATCH_ROWS", "2e8"))    # merged-surface rows per batch
am_per_batch <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("OCC_AM_PER_BATCH", "300"))  # AquaMaps models per batch
sp_cats      <- c("bird", "mammal", "turtle", "fish", "coral", "invertebrate", "primary_producer")
air_cats     <- c("bird", "mammal", "turtle")                      # effort = megafauna by default
stopifnot(occ_block >= 1, nc_div = occ_nc %% occ_block == 0, all(d_all >= 0), occ_ratio > 0, occ_ratio <= 1)

# paths ---- inputs are the SOURCE version's (default v10) merged outputs; caches live in this version's dir
ver_src      <- Sys.getenv("OCC_SRC_VER", ver_prev)
dir_src_v    <- ifelse(is_server, glue("{dir_derived}/{ver_src}"), glue("{dir_big}/{ver_src}"))
dir_src      <- path_expand(glue("{dir_src_v}/marine-atlas"))
sdm_src      <- path_expand(glue("{dir_src_v}/sdm.duckdb"))
dir_occ      <- path_expand(Sys.getenv("OCC_DIR", glue("{dir_big_v}/marine-atlas/occ")))
dir_tmp      <- glue("{dir_occ}/duckdb_tmp")
f_zone_cell  <- path_expand(glue("{dir_big}/zones/ecoregion_2025-06/global05/zone_cell.parquet"))
f_obis       <- path_expand(obis_h3_src("obis_cell.parquet")$path)
f_worms      <- path_expand(obis_h3_src("worms_taxon.parquet")$path)
f_csv        <- here("data/v11/zone_exclusions_occ.csv")   # the GATE (OCC_RULE=1 in merge_models)
f_wcsv       <- here("data/v11/zone_weights_occ.csv")      # the WEIGHTS (REGION_WEIGHT=1 in merge_models)
manifest     <- here("data/manifests/explore_occurrence_rule.json")
dir_create(c(dir_occ, dir_tmp, path_dir(f_csv), path_dir(manifest)))
stopifnot(
  "OBIS release is not on local disk (libs/obis_h3.R would read HTTPS; stage ~/_big/obis first)" =
    file_exists(f_obis) && file_exists(f_worms),
  "source version's sdm.duckdb not found" = file_exists(sdm_src),
  "ecoregion zone_cell extract not found" = file_exists(f_zone_cell))
obis_info <- tryCatch(obis_h3_info(), error = \(e) list(release = obis_h3_release, obis_snapshot = NA, worms_version = NA))

con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
duckdb_tune(con, dir_tmp)
q <- \(x) paste0("'", x, "'", collapse = ", ")   # SQL list of string literals

# the block (unit) of a cell: IDENTICAL to occurrence_counts_sql()'s arithmetic (checked below)
unit_sql <- \(id) glue(
  "CAST((((CAST({id} AS BIGINT) - 1) // {occ_nc}) // {occ_block}) * {occ_nc %/% occ_block} + ((CAST({id} AS BIGINT) - 1) % {occ_nc}) // {occ_block} AS INTEGER)")

message(glue("explore_occurrence_rule: source {ver_src}, OBIS {obis_h3_release}, d {d_default} km, ratio {occ_ratio}, test_n {occ_test_n}"))
```

The block arithmetic is repeated here (effort is looked up by block), so a toy run of the msens rule proves the two
agree: cells of one block share a verdict count, a neighbouring block does not.

```{r}
#| label: unit-check

cells <- c(a = 5 * occ_nc + 10 + 1, b = 5 * occ_nc + 19 + 1,              # same 10 x 10 block (row 5, cols 10-19)
           c = 5 * occ_nc + 20 + 1, d = 10 * occ_nc + 10 + 1)              # next block east / next block south
u <- dbGetQuery(con, glue("SELECT {unit_sql('c')} AS u FROM (SELECT unnest([{paste(cells, collapse = ',')}]) AS c) ORDER BY c"))$u
stopifnot("unit_sql: cells of one block must share a unit" = u[1] == u[2], "unit_sql: neighbouring blocks must differ" = length(unique(u)) == 3)
dbWriteTable(con, "chk_present", data.frame(mdl_key = "x", cell_id = unname(cells)), overwrite = TRUE)
dbWriteTable(con, "chk_occ",     data.frame(mdl_key = "x", cell_id = cells[["a"]], records = 1L), overwrite = TRUE)
dbWriteTable(con, "chk_effort",  data.frame(mdl_key = "x", cell_id = cells[["b"]]), overwrite = TRUE)   # b, not a: same block
dbWriteTable(con, "chk_region",  data.frame(zone_key = "Z", cell_id = unname(cells)), overwrite = TRUE)
chk <- dbGetQuery(con, occurrence_counts_sql("chk_present", "chk_occ", "chk_effort", "chk_region", nc = occ_nc, block = occ_block))
stopifnot("msens block unit disagrees with unit_sql" = chk$n_searched == 1, chk$n_occupied == 1, chk$n_cells == 4)
for (t in c("chk_present", "chk_occ", "chk_effort", "chk_region")) dbExecute(con, glue("DROP TABLE {t}"))
```

## WoRMS: records of a species, its order, the megafauna

OBIS records carry an AphiaID, which may be a synonym or an infraspecific name. Every record is credited to the
**accepted species**: the accepted name (`acceptedNameUsageID`), then, for a subspecies / variety / form, its parent
species. The accepted-species ids are then walked up `parentNameUsageID` to their **Order** and **Class**
(`worms_lineage`). The two effort groups follow: `order:{id}` = blocks with a record of any species of the order, and
`mega` = blocks with a record of any bird (Aves), mammal (Mammalia) or turtle (order Testudines).

```{r}
#| label: obis-sp

dbExecute(con, glue("CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW worms AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('{f_worms}')"))
dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE w_alias AS
  SELECT w.taxonID AS aphiaid,
         CASE WHEN a.taxonID IS NULL THEN w.taxonID
              WHEN a.taxonRank IN ('Subspecies', 'Variety', 'Subvariety', 'Forma', 'Subforma') THEN COALESCE(a.parentNameUsageID, a.taxonID)
              ELSE a.taxonID END AS sp_id
  FROM worms w
  LEFT JOIN worms a ON a.taxonID = COALESCE(w.acceptedNameUsageID, w.taxonID)")

f_obis_sp <- glue("{dir_occ}/obis_sp_{obis_h3_release}_y{occ_year_min}.parquet")
if (redo_occ || !file_exists(f_obis_sp)) {
  tmp <- glue("{f_obis_sp}.tmp")
  dbExecute(con, glue("
    COPY (
      SELECT a.sp_id, o.cell_id, sum(o.records)::BIGINT AS records
      FROM read_parquet('{f_obis}') o
      JOIN w_alias a ON a.aphiaid = o.aphiaid
      WHERE a.sp_id IS NOT NULL AND (o.date_year IS NULL OR o.date_year >= {occ_year_min})
      GROUP BY a.sp_id, o.cell_id
    ) TO '{tmp}' (FORMAT parquet, COMPRESSION zstd)"))
  file_move(tmp, f_obis_sp)
}
dbExecute(con, glue("CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE obis_sp AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('{f_obis_sp}')"))
obis_n <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT count(*) AS rows, count(DISTINCT sp_id) AS species, count(DISTINCT cell_id) AS cells, sum(records) AS records FROM obis_sp")
kable(obis_n, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = glue("OBIS records credited to accepted species ({obis_h3_release}; dated >= {occ_year_min} or undated)."))
```

## The scored taxa and where their modelled range lives

A scored taxon is `taxon.is_valid_usa AND taxon.is_marine` with `sp_cat` in the seven components (reptiles and
amphibians are not scored). Its **present** cells are `val >= 1` on the v10 merged GLOBAL surface
(`dist_merged_global`, built for the 2,105 range-constrained taxa); a taxon without one is AquaMaps-only, and its
present cells are the union of its `am` models (`taxon_model`), the surface the merge itself would have used. The
global surface is the right one (not the US trim): a zone is judged against the species' record rate across its whole
range. Which bucket directory (`b1` ... `b402`, and `turtle`) of the merged surface holds each key is read once (a taxon lives in exactly one).
BirdLife taxa carry a BOTW id, not an AphiaID, so they are matched to WoRMS accepted species by name; an unmatched taxon
has no records and every ecoregion comes out "unsearched" (kept), which is the safe direction.

```{r}
#| label: taxa-base

f_taxa_base <- glue("{dir_occ}/taxa_base_{ver_src}.parquet")
f_buckets   <- glue("{dir_occ}/merged_buckets_{ver_src}.parquet")
f_am        <- glue("{dir_occ}/am_models_{ver_src}.parquet")
glob_mg     <- glue("{dir_src}/dist_merged_global/dataset=ms_merge/**/*.parquet")

if (redo_occ || !all(file_exists(c(f_taxa_base, f_buckets, f_am)))) {
  con_s <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = sdm_src, read_only = TRUE)
  tx <- dbGetQuery(con_s, glue("
    SELECT ms_merge_key AS mdl_key, taxon_authority, taxon_id, scientific_name, common_name, sp_cat
    FROM taxon
    WHERE is_valid_usa AND is_marine AND sp_cat IN ({q(sp_cats)})"))
  tm_am <- dbGetQuery(con_s, "
    SELECT ms_merge_key AS mdl_key, mdl_key AS am_key FROM taxon_model WHERE ds_key = 'am'") |>
    semi_join(tx, by = "mdl_key")
  # which merged bucket holds each key (one scan of the key column)
  bk <- dbGetQuery(con, glue("
    SELECT DISTINCT mdl_key, regexp_extract(filename, 'dataset=ms_merge/([^/]+)/', 1) AS bucket
    FROM read_parquet('{glob_mg}', filename = true, hive_partitioning = false)"))
  stopifnot("a merged key lives in two buckets" = !anyDuplicated(bk$mdl_key), "bucket not parsed" = all(nzchar(bk$bucket)))
  dbDisconnect(con_s, shutdown = TRUE)
  write_parquet_df <- \(df, f) { dbWriteTable(con, "tmp_df", df, overwrite = TRUE); dbExecute(con, glue("COPY tmp_df TO '{f}' (FORMAT parquet)")); dbExecute(con, "DROP TABLE tmp_df") }
  write_parquet_df(tx,    f_taxa_base)
  write_parquet_df(bk,    f_buckets)
  write_parquet_df(tm_am, f_am)
}
rd <- \(f) dbGetQuery(con, glue("SELECT * FROM read_parquet('{f}')")) |> as_tibble()
tx <- rd(f_taxa_base); bk <- rd(f_buckets); tm_am <- rd(f_am)

# AphiaID of each taxon: WoRMS taxa carry it; BOTW taxa are matched to a WoRMS accepted species by name
nm <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT scientificName AS scientific_name, min(taxonID) AS nm_id
  FROM worms WHERE taxonRank = 'Species' AND taxonomicStatus = 'accepted' GROUP BY 1") |> as_tibble()
alias <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT aphiaid, sp_id FROM w_alias") |> as_tibble()
tx <- tx |>
  left_join(nm, by = "scientific_name") |>
  mutate(aphia = case_when(taxon_authority == "worms" ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(taxon_id)), TRUE ~ as.numeric(nm_id))) |>
  left_join(alias |> mutate(aphia = as.numeric(aphiaid)) |> select(aphia, sp_id), by = "aphia") |>
  select(-nm_id) |>
  mutate(
    sp_id       = as.numeric(sp_id),
    src         = case_when(mdl_key %in% bk$mdl_key ~ "merged", mdl_key %in% tm_am$mdl_key ~ "am", TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    eff_default = ifelse(sp_cat %in% air_cats, "megafauna", "order"),
    anchor      = scientific_name %in% c("Eubalaena glacialis") | sp_cat == "turtle") |>
  left_join(bk, by = "mdl_key")
n_nosurface <- sum(is.na(tx$src))
tx <- tx |> filter(!is.na(src))
if (occ_test_n > 0) {                                                            # smoke test: the anchors + an even spread of taxa
  keep <- sort(unique(c(which(tx$anchor), round(seq(1, nrow(tx), length.out = occ_test_n)))))
  tx <- tx[keep, ]
}
tx |> count(sp_cat, src) |> pivot_wider(names_from = src, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = glue("Scored taxa by component and where their modelled range comes from (no surface at all: {n_nosurface}; no AphiaID: {sum(is.na(tx$sp_id))})."))
```

```{r}
#| label: lineage

f_lin <- glue("{dir_occ}/worms_lineage_{obis_h3_release}.parquet")
ids_needed <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT DISTINCT sp_id FROM obis_sp")$sp_id |> union(tx$sp_id) |> na.omit()
lin <- if (!redo_occ && file_exists(f_lin)) rd(f_lin) else NULL
if (is.null(lin) || !all(ids_needed %in% lin$sp_id)) {
  dbWriteTable(con, "lin_ids", tibble(sp_id = as.numeric(ids_needed)), overwrite = TRUE)
  # walk each accepted species up the parent chain (<= 40 steps) and keep the Order and the Class on the way
  lin <- dbGetQuery(con, "
    WITH RECURSIVE up(start_id, cur, depth) AS (
      SELECT sp_id::BIGINT, sp_id::BIGINT, 0 FROM lin_ids
      UNION ALL
      SELECT up.start_id, w.parentNameUsageID, up.depth + 1
      FROM up JOIN worms w ON w.taxonID = up.cur
      WHERE w.parentNameUsageID IS NOT NULL AND up.depth < 40)
    SELECT up.start_id AS sp_id,
           max(CASE WHEN w.taxonRank = 'Order' THEN w.taxonID END)        AS order_id,
           max(CASE WHEN w.taxonRank = 'Order' THEN w.scientificName END) AS order_name,
           max(CASE WHEN w.taxonRank = 'Class' THEN w.scientificName END) AS class_name
    FROM up JOIN worms w ON w.taxonID = up.cur
    GROUP BY up.start_id") |> as_tibble()
  dbWriteTable(con, "tmp_df", lin, overwrite = TRUE)
  dbExecute(con, glue("COPY tmp_df TO '{f_lin}' (FORMAT parquet)")); dbExecute(con, "DROP TABLE tmp_df")
}
dbWriteTable(con, "worms_lineage", lin |> mutate(sp_id = as.numeric(sp_id), order_id = as.numeric(order_id)), overwrite = TRUE)
tx <- tx |>
  left_join(lin |> transmute(sp_id = as.numeric(sp_id), order_id = as.numeric(order_id), order_name, class_name), by = "sp_id") |>
  mutate(grp_order = ifelse(is.na(order_id), NA_character_, paste0("order:", sprintf("%.0f", order_id))))
tx |> count(sp_cat, has_order = !is.na(order_id), has_aphia = !is.na(sp_id)) |>
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = "Scored taxa with a resolved AphiaID and Order (an unresolved taxon has no records / no order effort: every ecoregion is 'unsearched').")
```

```{r}
#| label: effort-blocks

f_eff <- glue("{dir_occ}/effort_blocks_{obis_h3_release}_y{occ_year_min}_b{occ_block}.parquet")
if (redo_occ || !file_exists(f_eff)) {
  tmp <- glue("{f_eff}.tmp")
  dbExecute(con, glue("
    COPY (
      SELECT DISTINCT 'order:' || CAST(l.order_id::BIGINT AS VARCHAR) AS grp, {unit_sql('o.cell_id')} AS unit_id
      FROM obis_sp o JOIN worms_lineage l ON l.sp_id = o.sp_id
      WHERE l.order_id IS NOT NULL
      UNION
      SELECT DISTINCT 'mega' AS grp, {unit_sql('o.cell_id')} AS unit_id
      FROM obis_sp o JOIN worms_lineage l ON l.sp_id = o.sp_id
      WHERE l.class_name IN ('Aves', 'Mammalia') OR l.order_name = 'Testudines'
    ) TO '{tmp}' (FORMAT parquet, COMPRESSION zstd)"))
  file_move(tmp, f_eff)
}
dbExecute(con, glue("CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE effort_blocks AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('{f_eff}')"))
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT (grp = 'mega') AS is_mega, count(DISTINCT grp) AS groups, count(*) AS group_blocks, max(CASE WHEN grp = 'mega' THEN 1 END) AS x FROM effort_blocks GROUP BY 1") |>
  select(-x) |> kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = "Effort blocks (0.5 degree) by group: order groups, and the megafauna group (birds + mammals + turtles).")
```

## Ecoregions: the majority region and the buffered region

`occ_region` gives each cell to the ecoregion covering most of it (`msens::cell_zone_major_sql()`, ties to the first
key, the rule `zone_exclude_sql()` will delete under): PRESENCE is counted there. `occ_rec_{d}` is the same region
dilated by `d` km: every cell whose centre is within `d` km of a cell of the ecoregion (`msens::cells_within_sql()`, haversine
on cell centres, the column index wraps at the antimeridian); RECORDS and EFFORT are counted there. Each dilation is
cached as `region_rec_{d}km.parquet`.

```{r}
#| label: zones

dbExecute(con, glue("CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW zc_raw AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('{f_zone_cell}')"))
# present the extract in the v1-v7 `zone` / `zone_cell` schema cell_zone_major_sql() reads
dbExecute(con, "CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE zone AS SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY zone_key) AS zone_seq, 'ecoregion_key' AS fld, zone_key AS value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT zone_key FROM zc_raw)")
dbExecute(con, "CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE zone_cell AS SELECT z.zone_seq, p.cell_id, p.pct_covered FROM zc_raw p JOIN zone z ON z.value = p.zone_key")
dbExecute(con, glue("CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE occ_region AS SELECT cell_id, zone_key FROM ({cell_zone_major_sql()})"))
zones <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT zone_key, count(*) AS cells FROM occ_region GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1") |> as_tibble()
stopifnot("expected the 12 MMA ecoregions" = nrow(zones) == 12,
          "anchor ecoregions missing from the extract" = all(c("EBS", "GOA", "EGOA", "WCGOA") %in% zones$zone_key))

dbExecute(con, "CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW occ_rec_0 AS SELECT zone_key, cell_id FROM occ_region")
for (d in setdiff(d_all, 0)) {
  f <- glue("{dir_occ}/region_rec_{d}km.parquet")
  if (redo_occ || !file_exists(f)) {
    t0 <- Sys.time(); tmp <- glue("{f}.tmp")
    dbExecute(con, glue("COPY (SELECT zone_key, cell_id FROM ({cells_within_sql('occ_region', d, by = 'zone_key')})) TO '{tmp}' (FORMAT parquet, COMPRESSION zstd)"))
    file_move(tmp, f)
    message(glue("region_rec {d} km built in {round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = 'secs')))} s"))
  }
  dbExecute(con, glue("CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE occ_rec_{d} AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('{f}')"))
}
rec_n <- map_dfr(d_all, \(d) dbGetQuery(con, glue("SELECT zone_key, {d} AS d, count(*) AS cells FROM occ_rec_{d} GROUP BY 1"))) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = d, values_from = cells, names_prefix = "d")
zones |> left_join(rec_n, by = "zone_key") |>
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = "Ecoregion cells (majority region) and the cells of the region dilated by d km (columns d0, d100, ...).")
```

## Protected cells and batches

The protected override is about places, not ESA status: a zone holding designated cells of the species
(critical habitat from `ch_fws`, `ch_nmfs`, the NMFS core areas `ca_nmfs`) is never dropped, which is why both v7c
exclusions survive without carrying a status test. The three datasets' `mdl_key` are mapped to the merged key
through `taxon_model`.

```{r}
#| label: ch

f_ch <- glue("{dir_occ}/ch_{ver_src}.parquet")
if (redo_occ || !file_exists(f_ch)) {
  con_s <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = sdm_src, read_only = TRUE)
  tm_ch <- dbGetQuery(con_s, "SELECT mdl_key AS ch_key, ms_merge_key AS mdl_key FROM taxon_model WHERE ds_key IN ('ch_fws', 'ch_nmfs', 'ca_nmfs')")
  dbDisconnect(con_s, shutdown = TRUE)
  dbWriteTable(con, "tm_ch", tm_ch, overwrite = TRUE)
  globs <- glue("{dir_src}/dist/dataset={c('ch_fws', 'ch_nmfs', 'ca_nmfs')}/**/*.parquet")
  dbExecute(con, glue("
    COPY (SELECT DISTINCT t.mdl_key, c.cell_id
          FROM read_parquet([{q(globs)}], hive_partitioning = false) c
          JOIN tm_ch t ON t.ch_key = c.mdl_key)
    TO '{f_ch}' (FORMAT parquet)"))
}
dbExecute(con, glue("CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE occ_ch AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('{f_ch}')"))
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT count(DISTINCT mdl_key) AS taxa_with_ch, count(*) AS ch_cells FROM occ_ch") |>
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = "Protected cells (critical habitat + core areas), by merged taxon.")
```

Taxa are processed in **batches** so the multi-billion-row surfaces stream: merged-surface taxa by bucket directory
(about `OCC_BATCH_ROWS` rows each), AquaMaps-only taxa by `OCC_AM_PER_BATCH` models. The batch of a taxon is stored with
it; `counts/{sig}/{batch}.parquet` is the resume marker, and `sig` hashes everything the counts depend on.

```{r}
#| label: batches

if (nrow(tx) > 0) {
  bk_n <- dbGetQuery(con, glue("
    SELECT regexp_extract(file_name, 'dataset=ms_merge/([^/]+)/', 1) AS bucket, sum(num_rows) AS n
    FROM parquet_file_metadata('{glob_mg}') GROUP BY 1")) |> as_tibble()
  m_b <- tx |> filter(src == "merged") |> distinct(bucket) |>
    left_join(bk_n, by = "bucket") |> arrange(suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("^b", "", bucket))), bucket) |>
    mutate(batch = sprintf("m%03d", dense_rank(cumsum(n) %/% cap_rows)))
  n_am <- tm_am |> count(mdl_key, name = "n_mod")
  a_b <- tx |> filter(src == "am") |> arrange(mdl_key) |> left_join(n_am, by = "mdl_key") |>
    mutate(batch = sprintf("a%03d", dense_rank(cumsum(n_mod) %/% am_per_batch))) |> select(mdl_key, batch)
  tx <- tx |> select(-any_of(c("batch", "n_mod", "multi"))) |>
    left_join(n_am, by = "mdl_key") |>
    mutate(batch = coalesce(m_b$batch[match(bucket, m_b$bucket)], a_b$batch[match(mdl_key, a_b$mdl_key)]),
           multi = coalesce(n_mod, 0L) > 1L)
  stopifnot("every taxon needs a batch" = !anyNA(tx$batch))
}
sig <- substr(digest::digest(list(
  ver_src, obis_h3_release, occ_year_min, occ_block, occ_min_cells, occ_alpha, d_all, ratio_all, occ_ratio, d_default,
  occ_baseline, "msens 0.63.0 counts", occ_test_n, sort(tx$mdl_key), tx$batch[order(tx$mdl_key)]), algo = "xxhash64"), 1, 10)
dir_cnt <- glue("{dir_occ}/counts/{sig}")
dir_create(dir_cnt)
tx |> count(batch, src, name = "taxa") |>
  summarise(batches = n(), merged_batches = sum(src == "merged"), am_batches = sum(src == "am"), taxa = sum(taxa)) |>
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = glue("Batches (cache signature {sig}; {length(list.files(dir_cnt, '[.]parquet$'))} already done)."))
```

## Run the rule, batch by batch

For one batch: stream the batch's surfaces into `(taxon, cell)` pairs with `val >= 1`, then **reduce** them without
changing any count the rule takes: it uses present cells (a) inside an ecoregion (`n_cells`, and the protected test),
(b) as distinct 0.5-degree blocks (searched / occupied / totals), and (c) as a worldwide cell count for the
narrow-range override. So a species of at least `block^2 x min_cells` cells keeps every present cell inside an
ecoregion plus one representative cell per block (which preserves the block set, and still has at least `min_cells`
cells), and a smaller species keeps all its cells; a check below proves the narrow-range classification is unchanged.
The effort relation is the species' effort group restricted to the species' own present blocks (the rule reads effort
only there). Then `occurrence_rule()` runs: once at the D10 defaults (effort by taxon, d = `OCC_BUFFER_KM`, ratio
`OCC_RATIO`) and, for the sensitivity table, at every buffer x effort proxy with `ratio = 1` (the verdict at a smaller
ratio is the ratio-1 verdict with `rate < ratio x p_core` applied on top, which the tabulation re-derives with
`region_effort_test()` and checks against the default run).

```{r}
#| label: run-batches
#| message: false

thr_small <- occ_block^2 * occ_min_cells     # a species with fewer cells than this keeps ALL of them

rule <- function(eff, d, ratio) occurrence_rule(
  con, present = "occ_present", occ = "occ_records", effort = glue("occ_effort_{eff}"),
  region = "occ_region", region_rec = glue("occ_rec_{d}"), ch = "occ_ch",
  nc = occ_nc, block = occ_block, alpha = occ_alpha, ratio = ratio, min_cells = occ_min_cells, baseline = occ_baseline)

run_batch <- function(b) {
  f_out <- glue("{dir_cnt}/{b}.parquet")
  if (file_exists(f_out)) return(invisible(NULL))
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  tb <- tx |> filter(batch == b) |> mutate(k = row_number())
  stopifnot(length(unique(tb$src)) == 1)
  dbWriteTable(con, "occ_tx", tb |> transmute(mdl_key, k = as.integer(k), sp_id, grp_order, eff_default, multi), overwrite = TRUE)

  # 1. stream the surfaces into (k, cell_id), val >= 1
  if (tb$src[1] == "merged") {
    globs <- glue("{dir_src}/dist_merged_global/dataset=ms_merge/{unique(tb$bucket)}/*.parquet")
    dbExecute(con, glue("
      CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE occ_scan AS
      SELECT t.k, s.cell_id
      FROM read_parquet([{q(globs)}], hive_partitioning = false) s
      JOIN occ_tx t ON t.mdl_key = s.mdl_key
      WHERE s.val >= 1"))
  } else {
    am <- tm_am |> inner_join(tb |> select(mdl_key, k), by = "mdl_key")
    files <- glue("{dir_src}/dist/dataset=am/{sub('^am[|]', '', am$am_key)}.parquet")
    stopifnot("an AquaMaps surface file is missing" = all(file_exists(files)))
    dbWriteTable(con, "occ_am", am |> transmute(am_key, k = as.integer(k)), overwrite = TRUE)
    dbExecute(con, glue("
      CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE occ_scan AS
      SELECT a.k, s.cell_id
      FROM read_parquet([{q(files)}], hive_partitioning = false) s
      JOIN occ_am a ON a.am_key = s.mdl_key
      WHERE s.val >= 1"))
  }
  # worldwide present cells per taxon (distinct: a multi-model AquaMaps taxon repeats cells)
  dbExecute(con, "
    CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE occ_n AS
    SELECT k, count(*) AS n FROM occ_scan WHERE k NOT IN (SELECT k FROM occ_tx WHERE multi) GROUP BY k
    UNION ALL
    SELECT k, count(DISTINCT cell_id) AS n FROM occ_scan WHERE k IN (SELECT k FROM occ_tx WHERE multi) GROUP BY k")
  # 2. reduce (see the prose above)
  dbExecute(con, glue("
    CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE occ_present AS
    SELECT t.mdl_key, x.cell_id FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT k, cell_id FROM occ_scan WHERE k IN (SELECT k FROM occ_n WHERE n < {thr_small})
      UNION
      SELECT k, min(cell_id) FROM occ_scan WHERE k IN (SELECT k FROM occ_n WHERE n >= {thr_small}) GROUP BY k, {unit_sql('cell_id')}
      UNION
      SELECT k, cell_id FROM occ_scan WHERE k IN (SELECT k FROM occ_n WHERE n >= {thr_small}) AND cell_id IN (SELECT cell_id FROM occ_region)
    ) x JOIN occ_tx t USING (k)"))
  bad <- dbGetQuery(con, glue("
    SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (
      SELECT t.k, count(DISTINCT p.cell_id) AS r FROM occ_present p JOIN occ_tx t USING (mdl_key) GROUP BY t.k) a
    JOIN occ_n USING (k) WHERE (a.r < {occ_min_cells}) <> (occ_n.n < {occ_min_cells})"))$n
  stopifnot("the reduction changed a narrow-range classification" = bad == 0)
  n_in  <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM occ_scan")$n
  n_red <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM occ_present")$n
  dbExecute(con, "DROP TABLE occ_scan")

  # 3. records of each taxon (its accepted species, all synonyms / infraspecifics) and the effort relations
  dbExecute(con, "
    CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE occ_records AS
    SELECT t.mdl_key, o.cell_id, sum(o.records)::BIGINT AS records
    FROM occ_tx t JOIN obis_sp o ON o.sp_id = t.sp_id GROUP BY t.mdl_key, o.cell_id")
  mk_eff <- \(name, grp_expr) dbExecute(con, glue("
    CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE {name} AS
    SELECT DISTINCT p.mdl_key, p.cell_id
    FROM occ_present p JOIN occ_tx t USING (mdl_key)
    JOIN effort_blocks e ON e.grp = {grp_expr} AND e.unit_id = {unit_sql('p.cell_id')}"))
  mk_eff("occ_effort_order", "t.grp_order")
  mk_eff("occ_effort_mega",  "'mega'")
  dbExecute(con, "
    CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE occ_effort_default AS
    SELECT * FROM occ_effort_order WHERE mdl_key IN (SELECT mdl_key FROM occ_tx WHERE eff_default = 'order')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM occ_effort_mega  WHERE mdl_key IN (SELECT mdl_key FROM occ_tx WHERE eff_default = 'megafauna')")

  # 4. the rule: the D10 defaults, then the sensitivity grid at ratio = 1
  out <- list(
    rule("default", d_default, occ_ratio) |> mutate(run = "default", eff = "default", d = d_default, ratio = occ_ratio))
  for (eff in c("order", "mega")) for (d in d_all)
    out[[length(out) + 1]] <- rule(eff, d, 1) |> mutate(run = "sens", eff = ifelse(eff == "mega", "megafauna", eff), d = d, ratio = 1)
  res_b <- bind_rows(out) |> mutate(batch = b, n_scan = n_in, n_reduced = n_red)
  dbWriteTable(con, "occ_out", res_b, overwrite = TRUE)
  tmp <- glue("{f_out}.tmp")
  dbExecute(con, glue("COPY occ_out TO '{tmp}' (FORMAT parquet, COMPRESSION zstd)"))
  file_move(tmp, f_out)
  for (t in c("occ_out", "occ_present", "occ_records", "occ_n", "occ_effort_order", "occ_effort_mega", "occ_effort_default")) dbExecute(con, glue("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {t}"))
  message(glue("batch {b}: {nrow(tb)} taxa, {format(n_in, big.mark = ',')} cells -> {format(n_red, big.mark = ',')} kept, ",
               "{nrow(res_b)} rule rows, {round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = 'secs')))} s"))
  invisible(NULL)
}

batch_ids <- sort(unique(tx$batch))
walk(batch_ids, run_batch)
f_counts <- list.files(dir_cnt, "[.]parquet$", full.names = TRUE)
stopifnot("not every batch produced a counts file" = length(f_counts) == length(batch_ids))
res_all <- dbGetQuery(con, glue("SELECT * FROM read_parquet([{q(f_counts)}])")) |> as_tibble()
meta <- tx |> select(mdl_key, taxon_id, scientific_name, common_name, sp_cat, eff_default, src, order_name, class_name)
message(glue("{nrow(res_all)} rule rows over {n_distinct(res_all$mdl_key)} taxa"))
```

## Re-derive the ratio grid, and check the derivation

The sensitivity runs used ratio 1. The verdict at any smaller ratio is `region_effort_test()` on the stored counts
(the "unsearched" test does not depend on the ratio) with the stored override flag applied on top. Two checks make
the derivation trustworthy: at ratio 1 it must reproduce the stored verdicts, and at the default
(buffer, ratio, effort by taxon) it must reproduce the dropped set of the direct `occurrence_rule()` run.

```{r}
#| label: derive

base_cols <- if (occ_baseline == "zones") c("n_searched_zones", "n_occupied_zones") else c("n_searched_all", "n_occupied_all")
verdict_at <- function(x, ratio, cols = base_cols) {
  v <- region_effort_test(x$n_searched, x$n_occupied, x[[cols[1]]], x[[cols[2]]],
                          n_records = x$n_records, alpha = occ_alpha, ratio = ratio)$verdict
  ifelse(v == "dropped" & !is.na(x$override), "kept", v)
}
res_def  <- res_all |> filter(run == "default") |> left_join(meta, by = "mdl_key")
res_sens <- res_all |> filter(run == "sens")    |> left_join(meta, by = "mdl_key")

stopifnot("derivation at ratio 1 must reproduce the stored verdicts" = identical(verdict_at(res_sens, 1), res_sens$verdict))
# effort by taxon at (d_default, occ_ratio) from the order / megafauna sens rows == the direct default run
mix <- res_sens |> filter(d == d_default, eff == eff_default) |> mutate(verdict = verdict_at(pick(everything()), occ_ratio))
key <- \(x) sort(paste(x$mdl_key, x$zone_key))
stopifnot("derived default must reproduce the direct occurrence_rule() default" =
            identical(key(filter(mix, verdict == "dropped")), key(filter(res_def, verdict == "dropped"))),
          "derived default has other rows than the direct run" = nrow(mix) == nrow(res_def))
message(glue("derivation verified: {sum(res_def$verdict == 'dropped')} dropped pairs at the defaults"))
```

## The anchors, first

Two cases the rule must reproduce without any hand-written row: the sea turtles in the **East Bering Sea** (EBS)
and the North Atlantic right whale in the **Gulf of America** ecoregions EGOA + WCGOA. The Gulf of Alaska (GOA) is
shown beside EBS because v7c kept the turtles there; with OBIS alone it is reported, not asserted. Full rule rows
(`n_cells` = modelled cells in the ecoregion; `n_searched` / `n_occupied` = 0.5-degree blocks searched / with a record;
`n_searched_zones` / `n_occupied_zones` = the same over every ecoregion of the set, `n_searched_all` / `n_occupied_all` over the species' whole range; `p_core` = the baseline record rate (the other ecoregions under `OCC_BASELINE=zones`);
`rate` = the rate here; `n_min` = searched blocks needed for zero records to reject).

```{r}
#| label: anchors

v7c_turtles <- c("Caretta caretta", "Chelonia mydas", "Dermochelys coriacea", "Lepidochelys olivacea")   # dropped from EBS in v7c
anchor_cols <- c("common_name", "zone_key", "n_cells", "n_searched", "n_occupied", "n_records", "n_searched_all", "n_occupied_all",
                 "p_core", "rate", "n_min", "p_value", "verdict_raw", "override", "verdict", "label")
fmt <- \(x) x |> mutate(across(c(p_core, rate, p_value), \(v) signif(v, 3)), n_min = ifelse(is.finite(n_min), n_min, NA))
turtle_rows <- res_def |> filter(sp_cat == "turtle", zone_key %in% c("EBS", "GOA")) |> arrange(scientific_name, zone_key)
rw_rows     <- res_def |> filter(scientific_name == "Eubalaena glacialis") |> arrange(zone_key)
kable(fmt(turtle_rows)[, anchor_cols], format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = glue(
  "Anchor 1: the six sea turtles x East Bering Sea and Gulf of Alaska at the defaults (effort = megafauna, d = {d_default} km, ratio {occ_ratio}, OBIS only). A turtle with no row has no modelled cell in that ecoregion."))
kable(fmt(rw_rows |> filter(zone_key %in% c("EGOA", "WCGOA")))[, anchor_cols], format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = glue(
  "Anchor 2: North Atlantic right whale x the Gulf of America ecoregions (EGOA, WCGOA)."))
kable(fmt(rw_rows |> filter(!zone_key %in% c("EGOA", "WCGOA")))[, anchor_cols], format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption =
  "For context: the right whale in its other ecoregions (the stronghold the Gulf is judged against).")

anchor_ok <- list(
  turtles_ebs = turtle_rows |> filter(scientific_name %in% v7c_turtles, zone_key == "EBS"),
  rw_gulf     = rw_rows |> filter(zone_key %in% c("EGOA", "WCGOA")))
```

## Tabulation by component

"Kept" is the test's own verdict with no override; the two overrides are counted apart (a pair the test would drop but
critical habitat / a narrow range keeps), and "unsearched" pairs are kept and flagged (nobody looked). `cells` is the sum of
modelled cells in the dropped species x ecoregion pairs (`n_cells`).

```{r}
#| label: by-component

n_scored <- count(tx, sp_cat, name = "taxa")
tab_comp <- res_def |>
  group_by(sp_cat) |>
  summarise(
    species_with_rows   = n_distinct(mdl_key),
    species_dropped     = n_distinct(mdl_key[verdict == "dropped"]),
    pairs               = n(),
    kept                = sum(verdict == "kept" & is.na(override)),
    dropped             = sum(verdict == "dropped"),
    unsearched          = sum(verdict == "unsearched"),
    override_protected  = sum(override %in% "protected"),
    override_narrow     = sum(override %in% "narrow range"),
    documented_only     = sum(label %in% "documented occurrence only"),
    cells_dropped       = sum(n_cells[verdict == "dropped"]),
    .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(n_scored, by = "sp_cat") |> relocate(sp_cat, taxa)
tab_total <- tab_comp |> summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) |> mutate(sp_cat = "all", .before = 1)
bind_rows(tab_comp, tab_total) |>
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = glue("The rule at the defaults, by component. `taxa` = scored taxa run; `species_with_rows` = those with a modelled cell in at least one ecoregion."))

res_def |> filter(verdict == "dropped") |>
  count(zone_key, sp_cat) |> pivot_wider(names_from = sp_cat, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  right_join(zones |> select(zone_key), by = "zone_key") |> mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) coalesce(x, 0L))) |> arrange(zone_key) |>
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = "Dropped species x ecoregion pairs by ecoregion and component.")

res_def |> filter(verdict == "dropped") |>
  group_by(sp_cat, scientific_name, common_name) |>
  summarise(zones = paste(sort(zone_key), collapse = ", "), pairs = n(), cells = sum(n_cells), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(cells)) |> head(25) |>
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = "The 25 taxa losing the most cells to the rule (for eyeballing, not a ranking of importance).")
```

## Sensitivity: buffer x effort proxy x ratio

Each row is the whole scored set under one parameter choice; `effort` is the proxy applied to ALL taxa (`order`,
`megafauna`) or `default` (megafauna for air-breathers, order for the rest). The anchor columns say whether the
four v7c turtles fall out of EBS and whether the right whale falls out of EGOA and WCGOA. The D10 default row is marked.

```{r}
#| label: sensitivity

sens_one <- function(d_k, eff_k, ratio_k) {
  x <- res_sens |> filter(d == d_k)
  x <- if (eff_k == "default") filter(x, eff == eff_default) else filter(x, eff == eff_k)
  x <- x |> mutate(verdict = verdict_at(pick(everything()), ratio_k))
  dr <- filter(x, verdict == "dropped")
  tibble(d_km = d_k, effort = eff_k, ratio = ratio_k,
         pairs_dropped = nrow(dr), species_dropped = n_distinct(dr$mdl_key), cells_dropped = sum(dr$n_cells),
         unsearched = sum(x$verdict == "unsearched"),
         turtles_ebs = sum(dr$scientific_name %in% v7c_turtles & dr$zone_key == "EBS"),
         rw_gulf = sum(dr$scientific_name == "Eubalaena glacialis" & dr$zone_key %in% c("EGOA", "WCGOA")),
         goa_turtles = sum(dr$sp_cat == "turtle" & dr$zone_key == "GOA"))
}
sens <- expand_grid(d_k = d_all, eff_k = c("order", "megafauna", "default"), ratio_k = ratio_all) |>
  pmap_dfr(sens_one) |>
  mutate(anchors_out = turtles_ebs == length(v7c_turtles) & rw_gulf == 2L,
         is_default  = d_km == d_default & effort == "default" & ratio == occ_ratio)
sens |> transmute(`d (km)` = d_km, effort, ratio, `pairs dropped` = pairs_dropped, `species dropped` = species_dropped,
                  `cells dropped` = cells_dropped, unsearched,
                  `v7c turtles out of EBS (of 4)` = turtles_ebs, `right whale out of Gulf (of 2)` = rw_gulf,
                  `turtles out of GOA` = goa_turtles, `both anchors` = anchors_out, default = ifelse(is_default, "<- D10", "")) |>
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = "Sensitivity of the rule to the record buffer d, the effort proxy and the ratio (OBIS only).")
```

## Sensitivity: the baseline the record rate is judged against

Not written to the CSV: the same counts judged against the OTHER baseline. The default (`OCC_BASELINE=zones`, msens
0.63.0) compares an ecoregion with the species' record rate across its other ecoregions of the set (the 12 MMA
ecoregions, Tim's "US denominator"); the rule as first written (`range`) used the species' WHOLE modelled range. For a
species whose modelled range is far wider than where it is recorded (the right whale: IUCN range x AquaMaps suitability
covers the whole North Atlantic, records are on the shelf) the whole-range baseline is diluted (7,099 blocks, 352
with a record) and an ecoregion cannot be significantly below it, while the other-ecoregions baseline (41 % of blocks
recorded on the Northeast shelf) is what the anchor needs. Both are computed from the stored counts (no extra run;
the CH / narrow-range overrides are NOT re-derived, so the columns are "before overrides").

```{r}
#| label: baseline-other

alt_cols <- if (occ_baseline == "zones") c("n_searched_all", "n_occupied_all") else c("n_searched_zones", "n_occupied_zones")
alt_name <- if (occ_baseline == "zones") "whole range" else "other ecoregions"
def_name <- if (occ_baseline == "zones") "other ecoregions" else "whole range"
t_alt <- region_effort_test(res_def$n_searched, res_def$n_occupied, res_def[[alt_cols[1]]], res_def[[alt_cols[2]]],
                            n_records = res_def$n_records, alpha = occ_alpha, ratio = occ_ratio)
us <- res_def |> mutate(p_core_alt = t_alt$p_core, p_value_alt = t_alt$p_value, verdict_alt = t_alt$verdict)

us |> group_by(sp_cat) |>
  summarise(pairs = n(), !!glue("dropped, {def_name} baseline (default, before overrides)") := sum(verdict_raw == "dropped"),
            !!glue("dropped, {alt_name} baseline (before overrides)") := sum(verdict_alt == "dropped"),
            !!glue("unsearched, {alt_name} baseline") := sum(verdict_alt == "unsearched"), .groups = "drop") |>
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = "Pairs dropped by the rule under the two baselines (default buffer, effort and ratio).")
us |> filter((sp_cat == "turtle" & zone_key %in% c("EBS", "GOA")) | (scientific_name == "Eubalaena glacialis" & zone_key %in% c("EGOA", "WCGOA", "NECS", "SECS"))) |>
  arrange(scientific_name, zone_key) |>
  transmute(common_name, zone_key, n_searched, n_occupied, `rate here` = signif(rate, 3),
            !!glue("p_core, {def_name}") := signif(p_core, 3), !!glue("verdict, {def_name}") := verdict_raw,
            !!glue("p_core, {alt_name}") := signif(p_core_alt, 3), !!glue("p, {alt_name}") := signif(p_value_alt, 3), !!glue("verdict, {alt_name}") := verdict_alt) |>
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = glue("The anchors under both baselines (default = {def_name})."))
```

## Output: the gate and the weights the merge consumes

D11, "gate + weight": `msens::occurrence_exclusions(gate = "zero")` of the default run — a species leaves an ecoregion
only where it has NO record under adequate effort (`OCC_GATE=all` = every dropped pair, the rule as first written).
A species that IS recorded but at a rate well below its other ecoregions is not excluded: the first full run dropped
1,904 such pairs, among them the bowhead whale from the Bering Sea (23 of 458 searched blocks against 44 % elsewhere —
its wintering ground, surveyed mostly in summer when the whales are north), the beluga (51 of 604; coastal stocks),
the sperm whale and the common eider — seasonal or coastal presence the block rate cannot tell from absence. Those
pairs, and every kept pair below its reference rate, get `msens::encounter_weight()` instead: `w = min(1, rate /
p_core)`, a multiplier on the merged value inside the ecoregion under `REGION_WEIGHT=1` (default off; it inherits the
same survey-season bias, so it is a flag for the 2026-11-12 review, not a default). The shape and the extra columns
follow `data/v7c/zone_exclusions.csv` (`zone_fld`, the evidence). The full verdict table (kept / unsearched /
dropped, every pair) is cached beside the counts as `rule_default.parquet` for review.

```{r}
#| label: write-csv

ex  <- occurrence_exclusions(res_def, gate = occ_gate)
out <- ex |>
  left_join(res_def, by = c("mdl_key", "zone_key")) |>
  transmute(
    mdl_key, zone_fld = "ecoregion_key", zone_key, taxon_id, scientific_name, common_name, sp_cat,
    effort = eff_default, d_km = d_default, ratio = occ_ratio, alpha = occ_alpha, block_cells = occ_block,
    n_cells, n_searched, n_occupied, n_records, n_searched_all, n_occupied_all,
    p_core = signif(p_core, 8), rate = signif(rate, 8), n_min, p_value = signif(p_value, 8),
    verdict, label,
    reason = as.character(glue("occurrence rule E: {n_occupied} of {n_searched} searched 0.5-degree blocks hold a record (rate {signif(rate, 3)}), against {signif(p_core, 3)} in the species' {if (occ_baseline == 'zones') 'other ecoregions' else 'whole range'} (p = {signif(p_value, 2)})")),
    source = as.character(glue("OBIS {obis_h3_release}"))) |>
  arrange(mdl_key, zone_key)
stopifnot("every exclusion row must be a dropped pair" = all(out$verdict == "dropped"), !anyDuplicated(out[c("mdl_key", "zone_key")]),
          "under the zero gate every exclusion has no record" = occ_gate == "all" || all(out$n_occupied == 0))

# the weights: a pair the rule dropped on the RATE (records exist) is kept with its ratio; dropped-with-zero stays 0
# (redundant with the gate, by design); unsearched / overridden = 1 (unsampled is unknown, critical habitat untouched)
wt <- res_def |>
  mutate(verdict = ifelse(verdict == "dropped" & n_occupied > 0 & occ_gate == "zero", "kept", verdict)) |>
  encounter_weight() |>
  filter(w < 1) |>
  transmute(mdl_key, zone_fld = "ecoregion_key", zone_key, taxon_id, scientific_name, common_name, sp_cat,
            effort = eff_default, d_km = d_default, block_cells = occ_block, n_cells, n_searched, n_occupied, n_records,
            rate = signif(rate, 8), p_core = signif(p_core, 8), w = signif(w, 6), w_reason,
            reason = as.character(glue("encounter weight: rate {signif(rate, 3)} here vs {signif(p_core, 3)} in the species' {if (occ_baseline == 'zones') 'other ecoregions' else 'whole range'} -> w = {signif(w, 3)}")),
            source = as.character(glue("OBIS {obis_h3_release}"))) |>
  arrange(mdl_key, zone_key)
stopifnot("a gated pair must weigh 0 and a weighted pair must have records" =
            all((wt$w == 0) == (paste(wt$mdl_key, wt$zone_key) %in% paste(out$mdl_key, out$zone_key))) || occ_gate == "all",
          !anyDuplicated(wt[c("mdl_key", "zone_key")]))

# the full verdict table, for review (cache, not a deliverable)
dbWriteTable(con, "tmp_df", res_def |> select(-any_of(c("run", "eff"))), overwrite = TRUE)
dbExecute(con, glue("COPY tmp_df TO '{dir_occ}/rule_default_{sig}.parquet' (FORMAT parquet, COMPRESSION zstd)")); dbExecute(con, "DROP TABLE tmp_df")

if (occ_test_n > 0) {
  message("OCC_TEST_N smoke test: data/v11/zone_exclusions_occ.csv and the manifest are NOT written")
} else {
  write_csv(out, f_csv, na = "")
  write_csv(wt, f_wcsv, na = "")
}
kable(head(out |> select(mdl_key, scientific_name, zone_key, n_cells, n_searched, n_occupied, n_records, p_core, p_value, label), 15),
      format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = glue("First rows of data/v11/zone_exclusions_occ.csv ({nrow(out)} rows, gate = {occ_gate})."))
wt |> filter(w > 0) |> group_by(sp_cat) |>
  summarise(pairs_weighted = n(), species = n_distinct(mdl_key), `w median` = round(median(w), 3), `w < 0.25` = sum(w < 0.25), `w < 0.5` = sum(w < 0.5), .groups = "drop") |>
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = glue("data/v11/zone_weights_occ.csv: pairs weighted below 1 by component ({sum(wt$w > 0)} rows; {sum(wt$w == 0)} more are the gated pairs at 0)."))
wt |> filter(w > 0, sp_cat %in% c("mammal", "turtle")) |> arrange(w) |>
  select(common_name, zone_key, n_occupied, n_searched, rate, p_core, w) |> head(25) |>
  mutate(across(c(rate, p_core, w), \(v) signif(v, 3))) |>
  kable(caption = "The 25 most downweighted mammal / turtle pairs (recorded, but far below the species' rate elsewhere).")
```

## Manifest

```{r}
#| label: manifest

if (occ_test_n == 0) {
  h <- digest::digest(file = as.character(f_csv), algo = "xxhash64")
  by_comp <- tab_comp |> select(sp_cat, taxa, species_dropped, dropped, unsearched, override_protected, override_narrow, cells_dropped)
  write_manifest(
    manifest, target = "explore_occurrence_rule", content_hash = h,
    stats = list(
      version          = ver,
      source_version   = ver_src,
      msens_version    = as.character(packageVersion("msens")),
      obis_release     = obis_h3_release,
      obis_snapshot    = obis_info$obis_snapshot,
      worms_version    = obis_info$worms_version,
      channels         = list("obis"),                      # GBIF (speciesgrids), iNat, strandings: later additions
      parameters       = list(effort = "megafauna for air-breathers (mammal, turtle, bird), order otherwise", d_km = d_default,
                              ratio = occ_ratio, alpha = occ_alpha, block_cells = occ_block, min_cells = occ_min_cells,
                              year_min = occ_year_min, d_sensitivity = as.list(d_all), ratio_sensitivity = as.list(ratio_all)),
      n_taxa           = nrow(tx),
      n_taxa_no_surface= n_nosurface,
      n_rule_rows      = nrow(res_def),
      gate             = occ_gate,
      n_pairs_dropped  = nrow(out),
      n_species_dropped= n_distinct(out$mdl_key),
      cells_dropped    = sum(out$n_cells),
      n_pairs_rule_dropped = sum(res_def$verdict == "dropped"),
      n_pairs_weighted = sum(wt$w > 0),
      n_species_weighted = n_distinct(wt$mdl_key[wt$w > 0]),
      weights_csv      = list(path = "data/v11/zone_weights_occ.csv", rows = nrow(wt), xxhash64 = digest::digest(file = as.character(f_wcsv), algo = "xxhash64")),
      n_pairs_unsearched = sum(res_def$verdict == "unsearched"),
      by_component     = by_comp |> split(by_comp$sp_cat) |> map(\(x) as.list(select(x, -sp_cat))),
      anchors          = list(turtles_ebs_dropped = nrow(filter(anchor_ok$turtles_ebs, verdict == "dropped")),
                              turtles_ebs_rows    = nrow(anchor_ok$turtles_ebs),
                              right_whale_gulf_dropped = nrow(filter(anchor_ok$rw_gulf, verdict == "dropped"))),
      baseline         = occ_baseline,
      sensitivity_other_baseline = list(
        baseline = alt_name,
        pairs_dropped_before_overrides = sum(us$verdict_alt == "dropped"),
        turtles_ebs_dropped = sum(us$verdict_alt == "dropped" & us$scientific_name %in% v7c_turtles & us$zone_key == "EBS"),
        right_whale_gulf_dropped = sum(us$verdict_alt == "dropped" & us$scientific_name == "Eubalaena glacialis" & us$zone_key %in% c("EGOA", "WCGOA"))),
      exclusions_csv   = list(path = "data/v11/zone_exclusions_occ.csv", rows = nrow(out), xxhash64 = h),
      cache_signature  = sig),
    force = force_target("explore_occurrence_rule"))
  message(glue("explore_occurrence_rule: {nrow(out)} exclusion rows -> {basename(f_csv)} ({h})"))
}
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

## Assertion: both anchors fall out at the defaults

The rule is only adopted if it reproduces, with no hand-written row, what v7c did by hand. A failure means the
parameters, the effort definition or (most likely at this stage) the channels are wrong, not that the anchor is wrong:
the printed rows above say which of the three.

```{r}
#| label: assert-anchors

run_anchors <- occ_test_n == 0 || nrow(anchor_ok$rw_gulf) > 0
if (run_anchors) {
  stopifnot(
    "the v7c turtles (loggerhead, green, leatherback, olive ridley) must each have an EBS row" =
      setequal(anchor_ok$turtles_ebs$scientific_name, v7c_turtles),
    "right whale needs a row in both EGOA and WCGOA" = setequal(anchor_ok$rw_gulf$zone_key, c("EGOA", "WCGOA")))
  gated <- paste(out$mdl_key, out$zone_key)
  rw_w  <- wt |> semi_join(anchor_ok$rw_gulf, by = c("mdl_key", "zone_key"))
  # the turtles must be GATED (zero records); the right whale is gated or, with its handful of Gulf records, weighted
  # at or below the ratio (3 of 79 blocks vs 26 % on its other ecoregions -> w 0.14): Tim's "downweight, not drop"
  bad <- bind_rows(
    anchor_ok$turtles_ebs |> filter(!paste(mdl_key, zone_key) %in% gated),
    anchor_ok$rw_gulf |> filter(!paste(mdl_key, zone_key) %in% gated,
                                !paste(mdl_key, zone_key) %in% paste(rw_w$mdl_key, rw_w$zone_key)[rw_w$w <= occ_ratio]))
  if (nrow(rw_w)) message(glue("right whale Gulf weights: {paste(rw_w$zone_key, signif(rw_w$w, 3), sep = ' = ', collapse = ', ')}"))
  if (nrow(bad) > 0) {
    v_alt <- us$verdict_alt[match(paste(bad$mdl_key, bad$zone_key), paste(us$mdl_key, us$zone_key))]
    stop("ANCHOR NOT DROPPED at the defaults (effort = megafauna, d = ", d_default, " km, ratio ", occ_ratio, ", baseline ", occ_baseline, ", OBIS only):\n",
         paste0("  ", bad$scientific_name, " x ", bad$zone_key, ": ", bad$verdict, " (", bad$n_occupied, " of ", bad$n_searched,
                " blocks have a record against ", signif(bad$p_core, 3), " in the ", def_name, ", p = ", signif(bad$p_value, 2),
                "; need ", bad$n_min, " searched; ", alt_name, " baseline: ", v_alt, ")", collapse = "\n"),
         "\nOutside OCC_TEST_N the exclusions CSV and the manifest above were written regardless. Read the anchor and baseline tables: a failure means the baseline, ",
         "the effort definition or the channels (OBIS only) are wrong for this species, not necessarily the anchor.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  message(glue("anchors: the four v7c turtles are gated out of EBS; the right whale x EGOA + WCGOA is ",
               "{if (all(paste(anchor_ok$rw_gulf$mdl_key, anchor_ok$rw_gulf$zone_key) %in% gated)) 'gated' else 'weighted at or below the ratio'}"))
}
```
